comment: Download sources for the local LLM the Mystical Oak Tree uses to talk. 'model' is the portable .gguf weights, shared across all platforms. Each OS entry is the runner executable: fill in its 'url' (a direct executable or an archive containing it) and the 'executable' name to install/run. If a name is left empty it is taken from the url. Swap any of these out for backends you trust. Note HuggingFace links must use the '/resolve/' download form, not the '/blob/' page.
